verdict.rationale: Autumn calls itself an open-source control layer, and its GitHub repo shows the core app running on your own machine with the dashboard served on localhost. That evidence is a local development setup, not a documented production self-hosting path. missing for 10: production self-hosting/deployment documentation, infrastructure and configuration requirements, feature-parity statement versus the cloud offering, independent or hands-on reports of self-hosted use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Run Autumn: bun dev. That's it! You should be able to see the Autumn dashboard on `http://localhost:3000`.
